title: Duplicate entries in .gitattributes — housekeeping
description: Verified: .gitattributes contains multiple duplicate entries: '*.json text eol=lf' appears at lines 13 and 36, '*.md text eol=lf' at lines 10 and 41, '*.yml text eol=lf' at lines 42 and 52, '*.yaml text eol=lf' at lines 43 and 53, '*.zip binary' at lines 69 and 90. Git processes the last matching entry, so duplicates are harmless but create maintenance confusion.
spec:
1. Deduplicate .gitattributes by keeping only one entry per file pattern.
2. Organize entries into logical sections (text files, binary files) without duplication.
3. Verify with `git check-attr -a -- src/index.ts` that the attributes still apply correctly after cleanup.
